title: Pin the reviewed development scorer under the challenges milestone: one script run from main (retry of partial #250)
body:
## Goal
Session #250 ran `execution/scripts/land_scorer_review_247.py` correctly (all checks 0, evaluator missing [] with 51 references) but ended `partial` on session_budget at 14 of 15 turns, so nothing merged. Main still shows the challenges milestone `prepared-not-reviewed`. The script is idempotent and hash-gated; main still holds the reviewed bytes. Expected gain: the reviewed scorer (review #247 accept) becomes pinned evidence on main. The next Policymaker checks that main's benchmark/preparation-status.json has challenges `scorer-reviewed` and sha256 d32ec55004a1fb413e4555039f55c21c3a0222691c08cb2c21d0c495841c4558, and that the evaluator reports 51 references.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Turn 1: write `.session/report.md` (status in progress). Turn 2: run `python3 -I execution/scripts/land_scorer_review_247.py` once from the repository root. If it exits non-zero, report its message as `blocked`; do not work around it or edit outputs by hand.
- [ ] Turn 3: run `python3 -I policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` and `python3 -I benchmark/scripts/score.py --check`; both exit 0, evaluator missing [] and 51 references.
- [ ] Report the sha256 of benchmark/preparation.json (expected 07e30c21ecc205b74aaba561e147bc52e010ddcd41101e50417a13e38b388214) and benchmark/preparation-status.json (expected d32ec550...), then finish with status done. Nothing else is required: no extra exploration, no diffs, no reading other files.
- [ ] Do not run `git commit` (the parent commits). Do not delete the script.
## Verification
`python3 -I policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`
## Context
- execution/scripts/land_scorer_review_247.py: the whole change. #250's report shows the exact expected result.
## Budget
- At most 6 tool calls. Do not open benchmark/results/challenges.json, challenge JSON or case JSON.
